name: Legs Up the Wall Pose
description: Restorative pose lying on the back with the legs straight up a wall.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Sit sideways with one hip against a wall.
Swing your legs up the wall as you lower your back to the floor; put a folded blanket under your hips if you like.

keyframes.name: Lie on your back
keyframes.cue: Lie down with the knees bent and feet flat.

keyframes.name: Legs Up the Wall
keyframes.cue: Swing the legs up the wall and rest the arms.

cues: Move the hips closer to the wall as it feels comfortable.
